note: Chattahoochee County GA (Unified Government of Cusseta-Chattahoochee) publishes its zoning ordinance only as a PDF (Chatt_Zoning2019.pdf) with no zoning district polygon layer. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the county, RVRC and planning sites found no ArcGIS REST zoning service or downloadable zoning polygons. Only commercial parcel data (Rockford Map, Regrid) exists.
